data.body:
[P2] Revisit the validation design: CI omits the new tests

This filter starts `test-scripts`, but its explicit pytest file list omits `test_pr_status_labels_workflow.py`. Root pytest discovery also excludes `.github/scripts/tests`. Consequently, none of the five new contract tests runs in CI, so regressions in events or permissions can pass unchecked. Adding tests addresses the previous finding, but their CI integration exposes another blocking issue, triggering rule 8, “Repeated review findings mean a redesign.” Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, as rule 9 requires, and agree on validation that actually executes the caller-contract tests.
